videos.title: L_Ender's Cataclysm 1.20.1 (Full Mod Showcase) Epic Bosses

human_notes._source: guide (full showcase, transcribed) + jar (loot tables, recipe graph, eye recipes)
structure_gating: Every major structure is found with a crafted 'Eye of X' that works like an ender eye — this, not the fight, is the real gate, and all eight are craftable from VANILLA materials with no boss drop required

Ingredient tiers imply the intended order: mech_eye (iron/redstone) and desert_eye (emerald/sandstone) are cheap; monstrous_eye and flame_eye need netherite scrap; void_eye needs a shulker shell, so it is post-End
measured_emphasis: Across 2 transcribed showcases the two bosses guides actually dwell on are entity:cataclysm:ignis (18 mentions, 11 in praising language) and entity:cataclysm:the_harbinger (16) — roughly triple any other boss. Treat those two as the mod's headline fights
entity:cataclysm:ender_guardian (5) and entity:cataclysm:netherite_monstrosity (2) get far less airtime than their position in the ladder suggests
The items guides keep returning to are cataclysm:infernal_forge, cataclysm:bulwark_of_the_flame, cataclysm:mechanical_fusion_anvil and cataclysm:void_core — stations and defensive gear, not swords
entity:cataclysm:amethyst_crab is mentioned first (first_at 0.02) in one video: it is the early, harmless-looking mob players meet before any boss
boss_order: entity:cataclysm:netherite_monstrosity — nether boss; drops cataclysm:infernal_forge, the crafting station the later tiers need
entity:cataclysm:ignis — nether boss; sole source of cataclysm:ignitium_ingot
entity:cataclysm:the_harbinger — drops cataclysm:witherite_block, gating the witherite weapon tier
entity:cataclysm:the_leviathan — ocean boss; cataclysm:tidal_claws and cataclysm:abyssal_egg
prep: The guide's verdict on Ignis: 'only face this boss well prepared' — fire resistance is mandatory (it sets you on fire), plus healing potions, golden apples and enchanted netherite gear
Ignis applies Blazing Brand, which strips up to 20 armour and 5 toughness and life-steals off you — raw armour stacking does not work, mobility does
entity:cataclysm:netherite_monstrosity is asleep until you enter its structure, so the fight starts on your terms; it has 500 HP, 10 armour, 22 damage and enrages below 33%

entity:cataclysm:ignited_revenant blocks with a shield — the guide gives three specific counters: a crossbow enchanted with Piercing, breaking shields with critical hits, or hitting them while they throw bones
cataclysm:infernal_forge (from the Netherite Monstrosity) is a prerequisite station — cataclysm:brontes and cataclysm:void_forge are both built with it
cataclysm:mechanical_fusion_anvil is the witherite-tier upgrade station and itself costs cataclysm:witherite_ingot
Ignitium armour is applied to NETHERITE armour in a smithing table, so full netherite is a hard prerequisite for the mod's top armour
order: Ore/mob tier first: cataclysm:black_steel_ingot feeds the entry weapons (black_steel_sword, black_steel_targe) with no boss required
entity:cataclysm:wadjet and entity:cataclysm:kobolediator drop cataclysm:ancient_metal_ingot — the first boss-grade material, before the big four
Ignis is SUMMONED, not found: kill entity:cataclysm:ignited_revenant for cataclysm:burning_ashes, then use them on the burning altar (cataclysm:altar_of_fire) on the arena's upper floor
The altars (cataclysm:altar_of_fire, :altar_of_abyss, :altar_of_void, :altar_of_amethyst) are summon rituals, so several bosses need a fetch step before the fight exists at all
Each headline boss unlocks exactly one material, and that material unlocks a weapon/armour family — the mod is a clean one-boss-one-tier ladder
key_drops: cataclysm:ignitium_ingot -> ignitium armour set, cataclysm:bulwark_of_the_flame, cataclysm:the_incinerator
cataclysm:monstrous_horn -> cataclysm:monstrous_helm (guide: below half HP it knocks monsters back and grants defence/regen)
cataclysm:burning_ashes — from Ignited Revenants; the Ignis summon component, so it gates a boss rather than a recipe
traps: entity:cataclysm:nameless_sorcerer has a spawn egg but NO loot table and its own display name ends in '(W.I.P)' — do not build a kill task on it
The Leviathan is invincible outside water (the mod ships a dedicated 'the_leviathan_immune' message) — a land-based kill task cannot be completed

Do not target cataclysm:ignis_fireball, cataclysm:lava_bomb, cataclysm:tidal_tentacle, cataclysm:abyss_blast or cataclysm:void_rune: projectiles/effects with lang keys but no loot, egg or kill advancement
